description: CLI install plan for Linux aarch64. Compilable tools use source_build. ADFRsuite autosite is not built.

tools.name: PLINK 2.0
tools.build_cmd: env -u CC -u CXX -u CFLAGS -u CXXFLAGS -u CPPFLAGS -u LDFLAGS -u LIBRARY_PATH -u CPATH CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ make clean && env -u CC -u CXX -u CFLAGS -u CXXFLAGS -u CPPFLAGS -u LDFLAGS -u LIBRARY_PATH -u CPATH CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ make -j$(nproc) BLASFLAGS="-L/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu -llapacke -llapack -lopenblas"

tools.name: GCTA
tools.build_cmd: bash ../../../lib/patch_gcta_lapack.sh && test -f third_party/spectra/include/Spectra/SymEigsSolver.h || { mkdir -p third_party && curl --http1.1 -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/spectra-src.tgz https://codeload.github.com/yixuan/spectra/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.1 && rm -rf third_party/spectra && tar -xzf /tmp/spectra-src.tgz -C third_party && mv third_party/spectra-* third_party/spectra; }; git -c http.version=HTTP/1.1 submodule update --init --depth 1; mkdir -p third_party/openblas/include third_party/openblas/lib && ln -sfn /usr/include/aarch64-linux-gnu/cblas.h third_party/openblas/include/cblas.h && ln -sfn /usr/include/aarch64-linux-gnu/openblas_config.h third_party/openblas/include/openblas_config.h && ln -sfn /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libopenblas.so third_party/openblas/lib/libopenblas.so; export EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR=/usr/include/eigen3 BOOST_LIB=/usr/include OPENBLAS="$PWD/third_party/openblas" SPECTRA_LIB="$PWD/third_party/spectra/include"; rm -rf build && env -u CC -u CXX -u CFLAGS -u CXXFLAGS -u CPPFLAGS -u LDFLAGS -u CMAKE_ARGS -u CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH -u LIBRARY_PATH -u CPATH CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++ && cmake --build build -j$(nproc)

tools.name: fpocket
tools.build_cmd: perl -pi -e 's/\bclang\b/gcc/g' makefile src/qhull/Makefile; perl -pi -e 's/^CFLAGS\s+=/CFLAGS = -fpermissive /' makefile; rm -rf obj && mkdir -p obj && gcc -c -o obj/molfile_stubs.o ../../../lib/fpocket_molfile_stubs.c && perl -pi -e 's/^LFLAGS\s+=.*/LFLAGS = -lm -lstdc++ obj\/molfile_stubs.o/' makefile && make -j$(nproc)
tools.reason: arm64 pocket detection used instead of ADFRsuite autosite; no bioconda aarch64 package

tools.name: HOMER
tools.reason: HOMER configureHomer.pl is Perl-based and not verified on linux-aarch64 in this pass

tools.name: ADFRsuite autosite
tools.reason: x86-only ADFRsuite; arm64 uses fpocket + Meeko via platform override, not a source build
